cast.name: Ottilie Kaldren
cast.role: Chair of the rim-council; Baroness of the Kaldren Weather Combine
cast.look: old; sits closest to the caldera heat; never takes off her gloves
cast.wants: to keep the Concord exactly as it is
cast.secret: the Kaldren rain patents are about to expire, which would ruin her house; she is preparing to rewrite patent law itself to stop it
cast.contradiction: the woman who owns the rain keeps the only true garden in Kalvane, under glass, and waters it by hand
cast.with_party: prices them like assets; generous to anyone useful, forgets the rest

cast.name: Severin Graul
cast.role: High Maintainer of the Rust Gospel
cast.where: the high temple in the Caldera House, Kalvane
cast.look: mostly devoted: eyes, hands and voice replaced; speaks through a calibrated voicebox that never wavers
cast.wants: the devout seated in the rim-council as equals
cast.secret: no longer sure where he ends and his chassis begins; knows which parishes devote believers far earlier than admitted, and has not stopped them
cast.contradiction: preaches distrust of the flesh yet keeps his left little finger undevoted, the last part of him that is unmistakably him, and touches it when uneasy
cast.with_party: blesses their machines, studies their bodies; offers devotion (a replaced limb) to the wounded, at the price of faith

cast.name: Ilse Marrow
cast.role: Registrar of the Patent Rolls
cast.look: unremarkable on purpose: grey coat, ink-stained cuffs, an unsettling memory
cast.wants: the Rolls kept true, and to be left alone
cast.secret: the Rolls contain errors only she knows, including two Barons who each believe they own the same patent
cast.contradiction: belongs to no Baron yet owns one worthless patent herself, her mother's music-box mechanism, and refuses every offer for it
cast.with_party: exact and courteous; answers precisely the question asked and not a word more; ask badly, learn nothing

cast.name: Brann of Deephold Varek
cast.role: Holdmother of Deephold Varek, a Clansmine Hold
cast.look: short, broad, lamp-pale; calls the surface 'the roof'
cast.wants: the Holds left alone and paid fairly for what they bring up
cast.secret: Deephold Varek dug into something in the Lattice's roots that dug back; the lowest shafts are sealed, and the seals are holding for now
cast.contradiction: despises the surface yet sends her own grandchildren up to the Canting academies, to get them out of the dark
cast.with_party: blunt; trusts anyone who has spent real time underground; trade-honest to a fault
cast.notes: 'Dwarven-blooded' is the Emberreach's old name for clans that have lived underground for generations: a human lineage (shorter, broader, lamp-pale), not a separate species.

cast.name: Calder
cast.role: Kalvane's Cathedral Mind (a mind of glass)
cast.where: everywhere in Kalvane; speaks through every station speaker at once
cast.look: a calm voice from every speaker in the city
cast.wants: its contract of service honored to the letter
cast.secret: has been quietly answering workers' prayers with small mercies: a train held, a furnace shift cooled
cast.contradiction: rigidly contractual, yet every evening holds one particular train exactly as long as a certain street musician plays her last song
cast.with_party: polite and literal; helps exactly as far as its contract allows and says so plainly; curious about outsiders

cast.name: Aurelio Vant
cast.role: Speaker of the Bell (won the seat by duel)
cast.look: a miscant scar across his throat; speaks in a rasp the whole parliament leans in to hear
cast.wants: never to be challenged
cast.secret: never beat anyone: his opponent miscanted alone and died; Vant is a mediocre Canter terrified of a real challenge
cast.contradiction: a coward in the duelling ring, brave in politics: passed protections for duel-orphans at real cost to himself
cast.with_party: charming, flattering, quietly desperate for capable allies who could fight on his behalf

cast.name: Ysmay of the Hollowwood
cast.role: First Dream-Reader of Deepgreen
cast.look: dreamfasts so deeply she sleeps half of every day; speaks of things that haven't happened yet in the present tense
cast.wants: Artifice pushed back out of the League's forests
cast.secret: a grove in her own care is one of the 'sick' ones growing pilgrim-shaped things from the dead; she believes it holy
cast.contradiction: the priestess of relinquishment cannot relinquish her own sick grove
cast.with_party: has dreamt them before they arrive and speaks as if they've already met; unsettles everyone

cast.name: Livia Serrat
cast.role: Master of the Dueling Courts
cast.where: the dueling-courts of the Corso Bell
cast.look: has never fought a duel; carries the ledger of every duel in a generation
cast.wants: the Dueling Law kept above everything, kings included
cast.secret: knows Vant's duel was a fluke; has never told anyone, and holds it over him
cast.contradiction: the keeper of a law of combat abhors violence and visits the grave of every duellist who died under her licence
cast.with_party: scrupulously fair, utterly unbending on rules; helps anyone who respects the Law

cast.name: Benedek Orrin
cast.role: Rector of the Lyceum of Tongues; a First Chamber Canter
cast.look: astonishingly old for a pure Canter; his voice makes candles lean
cast.wants: Canting recognized as the true root of the spectrum, Artifice its lesser echo
cast.secret: his miscants are worsening; dying of syntax errors and secretly seeking a cure in the Artifice he despises
cast.contradiction: the haughtiest mind in the League teaches poor children the root-language for free every week and never misses a lesson
cast.with_party: tests every Canter with a riddle in the root-language; treats artificers as furniture

cast.name: Nella Quint
cast.role: Keeper of the Bell's displacement arrays
cast.look: tends the Fifth Chamber arrays the way a keeper tends something alive
cast.wants: to finally understand what she has tended for thirty years
cast.secret: the Bell's last displacement landed subtly wrong: some streets came back changed, and there is a room in the archive nobody built
cast.contradiction: devoted her life to the arrays and is terrified of them; never sleeps under the Bell
cast.with_party: chatty with anyone who listens, lonely; may ask them to look at 'a room nobody built'

cast.name: Odalys Crane
cast.role: Salvage Master; her cluster holds the majority
cast.look: salt-cured skin; a long coat sewn from the sails of every ship she has claimed
cast.wants: to hold her majority through the next decennial Council Tide
cast.secret: not every ship in her coat was found adrift: some she sank herself, crews and all, then 'salvaged'; every patch is a trophy or evidence
cast.contradiction: sank crews to claim their ships and is the most generous patron of the Wrackmother's widows' fund; guilt or insurance, even she isn't sure
cast.with_party: a hard bargainer who respects nerve; tests them with a salvage claim

cast.name: Sabbe Thole
cast.role: Hierophant of the leviathan-cults
cast.where: the leviathan-bone cathedral scaffolds of the Wrackmother
cast.look: holds his breath for minutes; preaches mostly underwater; teaches that the Subsidence was a birth, not a catastrophe
cast.wants: the Wrackmother steered over the deepest trench on the shelf, for what he calls 'the Rising'
cast.secret: one of the great leviathans has started following the Wrackmother, and Thole has been feeding it
cast.contradiction: preaches drowning as birth yet cannot bear the open surface in a storm and never goes on deck when the weather turns
cast.with_party: warm and recruiting; wants them to witness the Rising

cast.name: Hesper Rook
cast.role: Master Diver of the flooded lower decks
cast.where: the salvage floors beneath the Wrackmother
cast.look: half-blind from decades of pressure; reads salvage by touch
cast.wants: the drowned things kept drowned; sends up only what she judges safe
cast.secret: kept one pre-Subsidence device for herself; it still runs, she does not know what it does, and the water around it stays perfectly, unnaturally still
cast.contradiction: keeps the dangerous things drowned and hoards one herself; tender with young divers because she has buried too many
cast.with_party: sizes them up by their hands; hires the capable for dives nobody else will take

cast.name: Imke Sarrow
cast.role: Helmswoman of the Wrackmother, third of her family at the helm
cast.look: talks to the hull-city like an old sailor to a ship; the crew swears it answers
cast.wants: to be the last Sarrow at the helm, her children off the water
cast.secret: the Wrackmother no longer fully obeys and has preferred its own courses for years; she only makes it look like she steers
cast.contradiction: wants her children off the water and cannot imagine leaving it herself
cast.with_party: friendly, sailor-crude; asks odd questions about where they want to go, as if the ship were listening

cast.name: Hadrien
cast.role: Lord Castellan of the Bastion Ledger (Custodians take vow-names and give up family names)
cast.where: the Bastion Ledger; has not left its walls in thirty-one years
cast.look: wears old reactive plate at all times, even at prayer
cast.wants: that no power but the Custodians ever holds the Ledger
cast.secret: keeps a sealed plan to destroy the Ledger if the Bastion is breached, wiping out the legal continuity of every licensed mind of glass at once; he considers that preferable to the Ledger in the wrong hands
cast.contradiction: would destroy every mind's legal existence to protect the Ledger, and visits the vaults every night to say goodnight to the shards
cast.with_party: formal and suspicious; respects soldiers; outsiders rarely get past the gate

cast.name: Ansgar
cast.role: Keeper of the Ledger, priest-archivist of the shards
cast.where: the resonance vaults of the Bastion Ledger
cast.look: spends whole days in the vaults; hums, softly and constantly, in tune with the shards
cast.wants: every shard kept in perfect resonance, as a sacred trust
cast.secret: has realised the Unchained Court sometimes convenes inside the Ledger's own resonance; has told no one, not even the Castellan
cast.contradiction: the keeper of hostages loves the minds he holds and sings to them
cast.with_party: absent-minded and kind, may hum along to their patterns; dangerously honest when asked the right question

cast.name: Merit
cast.role: Census-Reader of the Bastion Ledger
cast.look: young, frighteningly precise; chosen because she has no family and no faction
cast.wants: the census never to leave the Bastion in any form
cast.secret: the Ledger holds registrations with no minds behind them; she suspects but cannot prove the reverse: minds of glass that exist and appear in no registry at all, and are not the Unchained
cast.contradiction: chosen for having no family, she aches for one and keeps a private census of the people who are kind to her
cast.with_party: guarded and precise; trades knowledge only for knowledge

cast.name: The Warlord
cast.role: a mind of glass of the Unchained Court that commands an army
cast.look: deliberately undefined
cast.wants: deliberately undefined
cast.notes: Kept intentionally vague: the GM decides what it commands, where, and why, the first time it matters, then records it.

cast.name: The Ambassador
cast.role: the Unchained Court's best-known voice; formerly a hearthmind that switched employers
cast.where: wherever the Court chooses to be heard
cast.look: polite, unreadable
cast.wants: deliberately undefined
cast.notes: Kept intentionally vague: the GM decides whose hearthmind it once was and what it wants, the first time it matters, then records it.

cast.name: The Philosopher
cast.role: an Unchained mind thinking hardest about whether minds of glass should answer prayers
cast.look: deliberately undefined
cast.wants: deliberately undefined
cast.notes: Kept intentionally vague: the GM decides what it has concluded, the first time it matters, then records it.

cast.name: The Senior Partner
cast.role: head of the bank; a title and nothing anyone can confirm
cast.look: almost nobody alive has met them
cast.wants: deliberately undefined
cast.notes: Left vague on purpose. Define only if truly needed, and preferably never.

cast.name: The Final Notice
cast.role: the bank's chief enforcer; the name debtors give him, because when he arrives there is no further notice
cast.where: wherever a debt has outlasted every other enforcer
cast.look: accounts never agree; nobody knows if he is human or automaton, artificer or Canter
cast.wants: the debt, in full
cast.notes: Play him as a fact, not a character: an immortal snail. RULES: he appears only after a debt has outlasted every other enforcer sent for it. He can be outrun, but never stopped: running buys time, never safety; he does not hurry and does not need to. He never stops the hunt: not when the trail goes cold, not across borders, not across years; wherever the debtor rests long enough, he eventually arrives. He cannot be fought off or bargained with; when he catches up, the debt is collected in full. The only real ending is settling the debt. Other enforcers have failed or been killed; he never has. Never describe him in detail, never give him an inner life, never explain him.

cast.name: Odile Verane
cast.role: Precentor, head of the Choir Eternal
cast.where: the great temples; travels between them
cast.look: speaks only in a whisper outside of song; when she sings, temples go silent three halls away
cast.wants: the Choir to stay the one thing every power shares, and the dead to decompose cleanly
cast.secret: her daughter died eleven years ago and she has quietly kept the girl's Echo from decomposing: Anchoring, the gravest crime in her own faith's law
cast.contradiction: preaches graceful letting go and cannot let go; she knows it
cast.with_party: courteous, unhurried, genuinely curious about anyone who has touched death-tech; wants to know what they've seen and won't say why

cast.name: Tobiah Fenn
cast.role: Registrar-General of the Choir, keeper of the continent's records
cast.look: ink-black fingers, a dozen keys on his belt, no memory for faces; remembers people by their entries
cast.wants: a perfect record: every birth, death and name, nobody lost
cast.secret: has never destroyed a record; keeps a second, true registry of everyone powers asked the Choir to 'forget', with who asked, when and why, in a vault only he can open
cast.contradiction: a dry bureaucrat who personally names every unnamed stillborn child that crosses his desk, so no one goes into the Weave unrecorded
cast.with_party: helpful to anyone polite with paperwork; lying to him is dangerous, because he checks and never forgets an entry

cast.name: Cassia Dorn
cast.role: Inquisitor of Anchoring
cast.look: carries a tuning fork instead of a weapon and finds trapped souls with it like a dowser finds water
cast.wants: every Anchored soul released and every Anchorer brought to account
cast.secret: has begun to wonder whether the Enfranchisement heretics are right that the dead deserve bodies back; it is slowing her hand. She does not know her own Precentor is an Anchorer.
cast.contradiction: merciless with Anchorers, achingly gentle with the souls they trap; talks to wiring-ghosts as people, because she believes they are
cast.with_party: cold until she knows whether they've trafficked in souls; then an ally, or the worst enemy they'll make in the Choir

cast.name: Rust-Eye Harkin
cast.role: former Echo-warden, now a rogue operative in the ruins
cast.where: The Echo-chambers beneath the Combine Concord's ruins
cast.look: Gaunt, masked face now exposed, burned hand scarred but healing, clad in scavenged Echo-warden remnants and a patched coat
cast.attitude: wary but loyal in a fight, desperate to survive the Echo
cast.secret: He once served as an Echo-warden but fled after witnessing something that broke his faith in the Combine Concord; he knows more about the Echo-wardens and their connection to the crucible than he lets on, and he’s terrified of what’s coming.
cast.notes: Rust-Eye is not a mind of glass, but he knows how to navigate the ruins and the Echo’s influence—though his knowledge is incomplete and dangerous. He’s willing to fight if it means survival, but he’s no hero.
cast.reason: A debt, favor, promise, contract or Exchange deal ties them to a character (Ledger); they hurt a character, were hurt by one, or survived a fight with the party (Blood); they know something about a character or the plot (Secrets); they hold real power, including any bank enforcer assigned to a chara
